en: Black-and-white postcard showing a two-storey building with a mansard roof, likely a small-town hotel, situated by a road with trees and grass in the foreground. Smaller buildings flank it on both sides. There is a flagpole in front of the central building. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small photographer/publisher logo is at the bottom right.
